panels.description: At the municipal counter, Guddu presents a smiling-premises photograph, ordinary fees and a replacement stamp pad. Chaudhary stamps the papers without changing expression. Keep upper-left counter space clear.
Pinty removes the cracked drive belt and fits a bicycle chain with pliers at the GODARAZ machinery bench. Keep top-left clear.
The bicycle chain turns and four pins reset slowly and noisily. Guddu watches, trying not to correct the repair. Keep lower machine space clear.
Duda grips the lane-3 ball return above the crowned lane while Billi occupies the other return. Behind them, the bilingual rule board has clear space for two exact contradictory lines.

items.speaker: PINTY
items.text: Give me one chain, one tractor and no speeches.
THE PARROT IS NOT AN UMPIRE.
the parrot is sometimes an umpire.

items.speaker: DUDA
items.text: Main umpire hoon. Also, I am not.
